# Rule: module-boundaries

Orders, Inventory, and Billing own separate business decisions and data. Modules may depend only on Core, Common, and explicitly published Interfaces. A module must not directly import another module or its storage. Cross-module calls use consumer-facing contracts. Keep composition in the application layer. Architecture changes update this canonical model before implementation. Ambiguous ownership, a new direct dependency, or a conflict with these rules requires the service owner's explicit decision; do not add an exception or waiver to continue implementation.
